legacy_observed.behaviour: PermissionError(13) read -> "cannot be read" branch (engine.py:1264-1270): file held, ZERO lots, .bak NOT offered; position untracked after pass 2; resume allowed (install_block only); the entry was refused only because the write-ahead save failed (OSError)

violates: D3 never an empty managed account
D4 explicit exchange/state reconciliation before management resumes
nc02_scenario: the snapshot path is a directory (layout), G-1 intact

nc02_required.R-IO-FAULT: an I/O fault on the store (ENOSPC, EROFS, a directory or other non-file at a store path, permission) means no intent can be made durable, so nothing is sent; it is reported out-of-band; no partial generation and no partial evidence is left behind
nc02_required.R-NO-EMPTY: an initialized account (marker or any store generation or evidence present) can never load as an empty portfolio; an empty portfolio is only legal for a first run whose exchange snapshot is flat (no positions, no open orders) or after an explicit owner adoption record
nc02_required.R-RECON-GATE: management (and every new-risk path, MANUAL included) stays blocked until a reconciliation record binds state generation G to an exchange snapshot that matches it (positions, open orders, protective orders) or the owner adopts/flattens each difference explicitly; resuming entries alone never clears it
nc02_required.R-HOLD: HOLD (Codex rulings 3 and 6): no new risk from any source (auto, manual, Telegram, UI, grid, maker); non-protective open intents are cancelled or drained through the priority queue; a late or partial fill is adopted and protected and stays blocked from new risk until reconciled; protective orders are kept; durable local append-only intent/result/incident events are allowed; no promotion and no reconciliation claim
